name: pool_get_stock
title: Pool: Get Stock
description: Get live Pool Gateway stock, no account needed.

name: pool_get_facets
title: Pool: Get Targeting Options
description: List the cities, states, carriers (with ASN and class) and IP classes that have stock in one country, with counts, no account needed.

name: pool_build_proxy_url
title: Pool: Build Proxy URL
description: Build a ready-to-use Pool Gateway proxy URL (gw.proxies.sx, HTTP 7000 or SOCKS5 7001).

name: pool_explain_error
title: Pool: Explain Gateway Error
description: Explain a Pool Gateway error and say what to do about it.

name: pool_get_my_credentials
title: Pool: Get My Credentials
description: Get your Pool Gateway proxy username and proxy password with ready HTTP and SOCKS5 URLs.

name: pool_set_proxy_password
title: Pool: Set Proxy Password
description: Set a new proxy password (at least 6 characters).

name: pool_get_my_stats
title: Pool: Get My Stats
description: Get your own Pool Gateway traffic and open connections, plus the health score of the pool and how many devices are connected to it.

name: pool_list_sessions
title: Pool: List Sessions
description: List your saved Pool Gateway sessions: pool, country, carrier, rotation mode, bytes and last activity.

name: pool_close_session
title: Pool: Close Session
description: Close one Pool Gateway session by the sessionKey from pool_list_sessions.

name: pool_close_all_sessions
title: Pool: Close All Sessions
description: Close every saved Pool Gateway session of the account.

name: proxies_modem_catalog
title: Private Modems: Catalog
description: List the Private modem plans for sale right now: country, carrier, period (day, week or month), price in USD, stock, OpenVPN and p0f support, regions.

name: proxies_modem_quote
title: Private Modems: Quote
description: Price check before spending.

name: proxies_modem_buy
title: Private Modems: Buy
description: Rent a Private modem (one dedicated 4G/5G modem, unlimited traffic) from the account balance.

name: proxies_modem_renew
title: Private Modems: Renew
description: Extend the rental of one of your Private modems from the account balance.

name: proxies_modem_rotate
title: Private Modems: Rotate IP
description: Ask one of your Private modems for a new IP address.

name: proxies_modem_mine
title: Private Modems: Mine
description: List your rented Private modems: status, expiry, online state, HTTP and SOCKS5 credentials, rotation settings, auto-renew, plus open orders and recent failures.

name: private_pool_list
title: Private Pool: List
description: List your Private Pools with their countries, status, gateway username, connection strings with the password masked (private_pool_reveal shows the key) and remaining GB.

name: private_pool_build
title: Private Pool: Build
description: Create a Private Pool paid from the account's existing GB balance: no purchase, traffic is metered from the same balance.

name: private_pool_reveal
title: Private Pool: Reveal Password
description: Show the gateway password (pak_ key) of a Private Pool.

name: private_pool_usage
title: Private Pool: Usage
description: Get the traffic of a Private Pool per day, in MB.

name: reserved_ip_list
title: Reserved IP: List
description: List the Reserved IPs a Private Pool holds: country, class, carrier, city, rotation mode, whether the device is online, the exit IP last seen, and connection strings with the password masked.

name: reserved_ip_reserve
title: Reserved IP: Reserve
description: Reserve one device for a Private Pool so no other customer is routed through it, and get its connection strings with the password masked.

name: reserved_ip_rotate
title: Reserved IP: Rotate
description: Move a Reserved IP to a different device in the same country now.

name: reserved_ip_extend
title: Reserved IP: Set Idle Window
description: Change how long a Reserved IP is kept without traffic.

name: reserved_ip_set_rotation
title: Reserved IP: Set Rotation
description: Set whether a Reserved IP moves to another device on a schedule: off (hold the device, the default) or every 5, 10, 20 or 60 minutes.

name: reserved_ip_release
title: Reserved IP: Release
description: Give a Reserved IP back to the shared pool.

name: get_account_summary
title: Get Account Summary
description: Get the account balance, free port slots, traffic bought and left, and any account alerts.

name: get_account_usage
title: Get Account Usage
description: Get traffic purchased, used and still available, split into Pool Gateway traffic and dedicated-port traffic.

name: get_pricing
title: Get Pricing
description: Get the live price per GB, the volume discounts, the free port-slot tiers and your current tier.

name: calculate_price
title: Calculate Price
description: Calculate what a GB amount costs with the volume discount applied.

name: purchase_shared_traffic
title: Purchase Traffic
description: Buy traffic in GB from the account balance.

name: coupon_validate
title: Validate Coupon
description: Check whether a coupon code is valid for an order, without using it.

name: coupon_redeem
title: Redeem Coupon
description: Redeem a standalone coupon that grants free GB or port slots to the account.

name: get_payment_history
title: Get Payment History
description: List the account's past payments and crypto top-up orders.

name: proxies_topup_checkout
title: Top Up Balance by Card
description: Add money to the account balance by card: creates a Stripe Checkout page and returns its url and sessionId.

name: proxies_topup_status
title: Top-Up Status
description: Check whether a card top-up started with proxies_topup_checkout was paid and credited to the balance (credited true or false).

name: create_crypto_payment
title: Create Crypto Payment
description: Create a crypto order that tops up the account balance and return its hosted payment link.

name: check_crypto_payment_status
title: Check Crypto Payment Status
description: Check whether a crypto order is still unpaid, confirming, paid, expired or cancelled, and whether the balance was credited.

name: get_pending_crypto_payments
title: Get Pending Crypto Payments
description: List the account's crypto orders that are not finished yet, with their payment links.

name: cancel_crypto_payment
title: Cancel Crypto Payment
description: Cancel a crypto order that has not been paid yet.

name: get_crypto_payment_info
title: Get Crypto Payment Info
description: Check whether crypto top-ups are available right now and which currencies the payment page accepts.

name: list_available_countries
title: List Available Countries
description: List the countries where a dedicated port can be created right now, with the countryId create_port needs.

name: list_ports
title: List Ports
description: List your dedicated ports with status, country, carrier, expiry and port ids.

name: get_port
title: Get Port
description: Get one dedicated port with its location and ready-to-use HTTP and SOCKS5 connection strings (contains the port password).

name: create_port
title: Create Port
description: Create a dedicated port on a carrier modem and return its connection strings.

name: delete_port
title: Delete Port
description: Delete a dedicated port and free its slot.

name: update_port_credentials
title: Update Port Credentials
description: Change the login and/or password of a dedicated port.

name: update_os_fingerprint
title: Update OS Fingerprint
description: Set the OS fingerprint (TCP/IP signature) a dedicated port presents.

name: reconfigure_port
title: Reconfigure Port
description: Move a dedicated port to another country, carrier or city.

name: extend_port
title: Extend Port
description: Add hours to a dedicated port's expiry.

name: get_port_status
title: Get Port Status
description: Check whether a dedicated port is online, offline or expired.

name: get_port_ip
title: Get Port Server Address
description: Get the server address a dedicated port listens on.

name: ping_port
title: Ping Port
description: Test that a dedicated port answers and measure its latency.

name: speed_test_port
title: Speed Test Port
description: Run a speed test through a dedicated port (download, upload, ping).

name: rotate_port
title: Rotate Port
description: Move a dedicated port to another modem in the same location.

name: check_rotation_availability
title: Check Rotation Availability
description: Check whether a dedicated port can be rotated now, how long the cooldown still runs and how many other modems are free.

name: configure_auto_rotation
title: Configure Auto Rotation
description: Turn automatic rotation of a dedicated port on or off and set its interval.

name: get_rotation_history
title: Get Rotation History
description: Get the past rotations of a dedicated port: when, how triggered, the location it moved to and whether it worked.

name: get_rotation_token_url
title: Get Rotation Token URL
description: Get the public rotation link of a dedicated port.

name: get_proxy_connection_string
title: Get Proxy Connection String
description: Build the HTTP or SOCKS5 connection string of a dedicated port (contains the port password).

name: get_all_proxy_formats
title: Get All Proxy Formats
description: Get a dedicated port in every common format: URLs, host:port, environment variables, curl, Python and Node.js snippets, and its public rotation link.

name: get_service_status
title: Get Service Status
description: Check whether Proxies.sx is healthy right now: open Pool Gateway incidents, the state of the API, gateway and relay, and recent uptime.

name: get_os_fingerprint_options
title: Get OS Fingerprint Options
description: List the OS fingerprint values create_port and update_os_fingerprint accept.

name: create_support_ticket
title: Create Support Ticket
description: Open a support ticket that a person at Proxies.sx reads and answers.

name: list_my_tickets
title: List My Tickets
description: List your support tickets with their status and IDs.

name: get_ticket
title: Get Ticket
description: Get one support ticket with the original message and every reply.

name: reply_to_ticket
title: Reply to Ticket
description: Add a reply to one of your support tickets.

name: close_ticket
title: Close Ticket
description: Close one of your support tickets once the problem is solved.

name: pool_mint_key

description: Create a Pool Access Key (pak_) for one of your customers; it is used as the proxy password.

name: pool_list_keys
title: Pool: List Access Keys

name: pool_topup_key
title: Pool: Top Up Access Key
description: Add GB to a Pool Access Key's cap and/or extend its expiry in one step.

name: pool_update_key
title: Pool: Update Access Key
description: Change a Pool Access Key's label, enabled flag, cap, expiry or quality tier.

name: pool_regenerate_key
title: Pool: Regenerate Access Key
description: Replace the secret pak_ value of a Pool Access Key.

name: pool_reveal_key
title: Pool: Reveal Access Key
description: Show the full pak_ value of a Pool Access Key.

name: pool_delete_key
title: Pool: Delete Access Key
description: Delete a Pool Access Key.

name: pool_key_usage
title: Pool: Access Key Usage
description: Get the traffic of one Pool Access Key per day, in MB.

name: pool_key_audit

description: Get the audit log of one Pool Access Key, newest first: created, changed, topped up, regenerated, revealed, deleted, and gateway logins that worked or failed.

name: ops_credit_balance

name: ops_list_farmers
